# AVP 0.4 conformance vectors (vendored, legacy)

These JSON files are copied verbatim from the Alt Vault Protocol spec repository,
`trqlmao/avp` under `vectors/` (as of commit `5fb48e8`, protocol 0.4). They are the
**source of truth** for the 0.4 constructions; do not edit them here.

They stay because the read-only 0.4 importer is still gated by them. AVP 0.5 replaced
the protocol and its vectors (one directory up); 0.4 is frozen, so this set is never
updated. It goes when the last 0.4 reader goes.
